ideas.insider_angle: While Levi's 'Imagine on Me' and Gap AI fit require users to navigate to a retailer's app or website, Glance's VTON operates via Gemini agents within an agentic chat surface pre-installed on Samsung and Motorola devices — zero install, zero navigation, zero funnel. ideas.opening_hook: Virtual try-on has been fashion tech's most-promised, least-used feature for five years — not because the technology isn't good enough, but because you have to download an app, create an account, and navigate four menus before you can try on a jacket you found on a lockscreen.
